snippet.title: Pharm Pharaoh 0.2.6 - Gameplay Sample - 09/02/2024
snippet.description:
#PharmPharaoh

Pharm Pharaoh 0.2.6 is out!

Feel free to check out this pharmaceutical pathfinding puzzle game developed by Jia Jie Chen!
With the new Un-Pholding expansion, get ready to go beyond the realm of pharmaceuticals with access to PubChem!
Free demo and paid versions are now available via Itch: https://jiajiechen.itch.io/pharm-pharaoh
Now available for Windows exe and Android apk.
